project.title: activated sludge metagenome Raw sequence reads
project.description: Aerobic coking sewage sludge was inoculated in an AnMBR (anaerobic membrane bioreactor), which was designed to improve the removal rate of organic pollutants for coking wastewater treatment. Aiming at revealing the dynamic changes of microbial community treating coking wastewater in the process of conversion from aerobic to anaerobic.
